window.note: The judge's confirmation window (metadata/pressure_judge.json). Near-blind: its days were opened once, on 2026-10-05, for the final test (#151), and are ordinary history in metadata/lockbox.json; the judge's confirmation.candidates is the gate. When the window is opened, the opening is also recorded in metadata/lockbox.json (Eleonora's attested action; this record does not make that edit).

panel.note: The published panel rebuilt from the tracked fixtures (REPRODUCIBILITY.md); verify-panel is clean. The scratch panels the candidates are scored on are built from it by the scripts named per candidate.

judge.primary_test: The pressure-day judge as in force at frozen_at.commit: a pressure day is SOFR - IORB > +5 bp (strictly, on whole basis points); tier 1 (onset warning) is the primary test.
judge.pass_rule: As in src/repo_model/pressure_judge.py and docs/decisions/judge-rulings-10-october.md: tier 1 at lead >= 1, tier 3 at every lead, and tier 5, under the weighted miss rule in force (docs/decisions/weighted-miss.md). Recall and false alarms inside and outside 2018-19, the per-lead readings and the equal-weight-per-regime recall are reported, not tiers. The confirmation look scores 2026-01-01 to 2026-09-03 and nothing else (pressure_judge.require_scored_days).

benchmarks.how: Each candidate is scored by the judge's own benchmarks, produced the way every candidate is (pressure_judge.benchmark_forecasts, scripts/pressure_judge.py forecasts), paired on the same days, with the judge's stationary-bootstrap interval (metadata/pressure_judge.json, bootstrap), split by regime, scarcity state and pressure-day type (the judge's groupings). A pooled figure alone is not a result.

comparison.correction: Holm's step-down method across the two secondary candidates, on the same paired tier 1 contrast, family-wise level 0.10. The 90% intervals are reported beside the adjusted result. The pass rule itself is read as in force, unadjusted, and is reported for all three.
comparison.among_the_three: The primary is the only candidate whose result is the confirmation claim; the other two are secondary. The three are compared with one another only through the same paired differences; no winner is declared from a pooled figure. The selection is the three; no fourth candidate is added after the window is read.
comparison.status: Decided by Eleonora, 12 October 2026 (her attested comment on PR #593, performed_via_github_app null): one named primary tested without correction, the two secondary corrected with Holm's method.
comparison.primary_correction: none: the single named primary is tested at the judge's own level (90% paired interval, metadata/pressure_judge.json), without correction.
comparison.primary_contrast: For each candidate, the judge's tier 1 recall condition: recall of onsets warned at lead >= 1 against calendar_climatology at the same false-alarm rate, paired, with the bootstrap interval.

opening.how: Naming the three candidates in confirmation.candidates of metadata/pressure_judge.json, with Eleonora's own attestation (metadata/owner_attestations.json, #256), and recording the opening in metadata/lockbox.json. repo_model.confirmation.require_confirmation_open refuses a window day for a candidate until the candidates are named, and for every candidate if a hashed file no longer matches.
